interpretation.weekly_round_tables: Contain player credits (cr) and fantasy results (pdk) together, but do not contain a capture timestamp or explicit as-of/pre-game marker. Treat same-round cr as unsafe for pre-game features until source semantics are independently verified; using the prior completed round is safer but is only a lagged proxy.
interpretation.pre_match_snapshots: Contain explicit current-market captures (player credits, coach market, injuries, lineup availability, fixture mapping) under prediction run directories. These are point-in-time snapshots for the 2026/27 opener period, not historical captures spanning prior seasons.
interpretation.missing_historical_features: No confirmed multi-season timestamped pre-game injury, availability, coach-market, or player-credit snapshots were found in the inventory. Weekly results can support lagged form features, not reconstruct exact pre-game roster state on their own.
